environment.description: Apollo Server v4 running on ECS Fargate behind an Application Load Balancer with no WAF association. The ALB forwards all traffic directly to the container on port 4000. Prisma ORM connected to Aurora PostgreSQL with the User model containing columns: id, email, name, role, isAdmin, apiQuota, department. No input sanitization middleware. GraphQL introspection disabled in production but the schema is known.

config.load_balancer: ALB with default listener, no WAF attached
config.network: VPC with public ALB, private subnets for ECS tasks
config.input_validation: GraphQL type system only (bypassed via raw body parsing)
